resources.string: "• 1% = 10,000 PPM • Federal PEL for NH3 is 50 PPM • Federal STEL for NH3 is 35 PPM • Federal IDLH for NH3 is 300 PPM • Hydrostatic Expansion for NH3 is 100 PSI – 150 PSI per °F of heat exposure • Liquid NH3 swelling effect is 20% it’s original size under standard atmospheric temperatures. • Liquid NH3 expansion rate at standard atmospheric pressure is 768:1 • H20 absorption rate of NH3 gas is 1,300:1 • 2.5 gallons of water to dilute one pound of ammonia gas • PH of NH3 is about 11.6 • Oils can absorb approximately ½% of ammonia gas by volume • 1mA is 1/1,000 of an amp • 1 HP = 2,545 BTU’s of Energy • Three-Phase kW = {(Amps x Volts x Power Factor x 1.73) / 1,000} • Single-Phase kw = {(Amps x Volts x Power Factor) / 1,000} • kW = 3,412 BTU’s of Energy per Hour = 28.6% of a Ton • 1 HP = 0.746 kilowatts = 746 watts • BHP Single-Phase = {(Volts x Amps x % Efficient x Power Factor) / 746} • BHP Three-Phase = {(Volts x Amps x % Efficient x Power Factor x 1.73) / 746} • 200 BTU’s / Min = 1 Ton of Refrigeration • 12,000 BTU’s / Hour = 1 Ton of Refrigeration • 288,000 BTU’s / 24 Hours = 1 Ton of Refrigeration • Volume of a cylinder is = (Length x Radius x Radius x π) • Volume of a Rectangle/Square = (Length x Width x Height) • Compression Ratio = (Discharge Pressure in PSIA / Suction Pressure in PSIA) • NH3 latent heat of boiling is approximately 561 BTU’s • H20 latent heat of boiling is approximately 970 BTU’s • H20 latent heat of freezing is approximately 144 BTU’s • C = {(F – 32) / 1.8} • F = {(C x 1.8) + 32} • Sensible Heat Equation: BTU’s = {Mass x Specific Heat x (T1 – T2)} • Latent Heat Equation: BTU’s = (Mass x Latent Heat of Freezing) • Specific Heat (Cp) of liquid H20 is 1.0 • Specific Heat (Cp) of liquid NH3 is 1.12 • Pressure = (Force / Area) • PSIA = {14.7 – (“Hg / 2.035)} • PSIA = (14.7 + PSIG) • PSIG = (PSIA – 14.7) • 1 BARa = 14.7 PSIA = 0 PSIG = 0”Hg • Flash / Tax Gas % for NH3 = {(TD x 1.12) / 561}"
